## What's new in QOTA 16.10.2

- The multistage Dockerfile uses Bench to install official Frappe v16 and QOTA from their repositories and compile their assets. Deployment scripts and Nginx configuration now live under `docker/resources/`. This removes the standalone installers and asset packaging script.
- Run `configure.sh` to prepare the shared Bench configuration, then run `create-site.sh` to provision a new site. `INSTALL_APPS` defaults to `qota`. The creation job skips existing sites, and operators run any required `bench migrate` separately.
- Nginx serves `sites/assets` by default. For an alternate directory, set `ASSETS_PATH` on both the configurator and frontend. The configurator validates `assets.json`, `assets-rtl.json`, and their referenced files before copying changed manifests to the sites volume, then invalidates the Redis key `assets_json`.
- Derived images can add Messaging and qota_preset. Add both apps and compile their bundles in the derived image, then include them in `INSTALL_APPS` when provisioning new sites that need them.

## Upgrading from 16.10.1

Keep the existing sites and logs volumes. Update the Compose jobs to use the new scripts and clear any override that still points to the retired entrypoint. If `sites/assets` in the sites volume still links to the old image asset directory, prepare a real directory for the new manifests and bundles before running the configurator. See the Docker deployments section of README.md for the Compose commands and asset mounts.
